description: Enrich a developer from their GitHub profile URL — full firmographic + technical profile. Returns name, location, company, followers, years active, seniority estimate, and a ranked skills breakdown (languages by repo share). Use to enrich a lead or candidate you already have a GitHub URL for. Example: revternal_enrich_developer({ github_url: "https://github.com/torvalds" }).

_apiKey.description: Revternal API key (x-api-key). Injected from the platform key when omitted.
